/theme-parks/alton-towers-resort/alton.title: Alton Towers Resort — a theme park day out
/theme-parks/alton-towers-resort/alton.body:
Big rides, small explorers and a proper day out

Somebody will say they are only coming for a gentle look around. Give it ten minutes and they will be studying the ride map. Alton Towers Resort brings a theme park, waterpark and places to stay together, so decide which part of the adventure you are booking before you set off.

The theme-park visit and the waterpark are separate plans. Check the ticket inclusions rather than assuming one admission covers everything. The resort’s own planning pages have the current opening calendar, directions and help with tickets, facilities and access arrangements.

Give the day a bit of shape

Pick the rides or areas your group is most excited about, then leave room for the journey between them. Look at height restrictions and access information before you promise a particular ride to a younger visitor. A food break belongs in the plan too; nobody does their best queueing while hungry.

For a longer break, compare the resort’s accommodation options with your chosen park dates. Read the package details, parking arrangements and cancellation terms. A room booking and a day ticket are different purchases unless the package explicitly includes both.

Before you book

Use the official website for the current ticket choices and operating dates. If you have a voucher or promotional offer, check how to redeem it and any date restrictions before paying. Choose the day that suits your group, get the essentials sorted and enjoy looking forward to it.

Guide information checked against Alton Towers Resort and its visit-planning information on 12 October 2026.

/theme-parks/drayton-manor-resort/tamwor.title: Drayton Manor Resort — family fun near Tamworth
/theme-parks/drayton-manor-resort/tamwor.body:
All aboard for a very good day out

For the Thomas fan in your group, this is the sort of outing that starts being discussed well before breakfast. Drayton Manor Resort near Tamworth combines Thomas Land, the wider theme park and a zoo. You can make the trains your main event or put together a day with a different mix of rides and discoveries.

Start with the favourites

Thomas Land’s own guide lists themed rides and attractions featuring familiar engines and characters. Look at the current ride information with your group before you arrive. Pick a few favourites, check the height and accompanying-adult rules, and leave time for the stops between them.

The wider park has other themed areas, including Adventure Cove, Vikings and Frontier Falls. Use the current park map to work out a route that fits the people coming with you. There is no prize for crossing the park six times because nobody looked at the map.

Swap the ride queue for a wildlife wander

The zoo adds an animal stop and a change of pace within the resort. Drayton Manor describes quieter open spaces as well as its animal displays. If your group would enjoy a slower spell, give the zoo its own place in the day rather than trying to squeeze it into the final few minutes.

Plan the date, then enjoy the anticipation

Check the opening calendar and ride-availability page before booking. Look at the ticket inclusions, parking and access information, and sort out any dietary requirements with the venue. Stay & Play packages are a separate option if you want to extend the visit; read what the particular package includes.

Guide sources checked on 12 October 2026: Thomas Land, Drayton Manor Zoo and the opening calendar.
